jobs.title: Senior Manager - Engagement Management Consultant
jobs.description:
This job posting is anticipated to remain open for 30 days, from 17-Sep-2026. The posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.
The Senior Manager - Engagement Management Consultant is a senior advisor and delivery leader who partners directly with business owners and enterprise leaders to shape and execute high‑impact AI, emerging technology, and analytics initiatives. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, innovation, and execution, helping turn ambitious ideas into measurable business outcomes.

Serving as a trusted consultant, you will translate complex and ambiguous strategic priorities into actionable solution designs, align diverse stakeholders, and ensure initiatives deliver real business value. As a leader within a small, high‑impact consulting team, you will bridge vision and execution—moving initiatives from concept to reality in a fast‑changing technology landscape.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with senior leaders, thrives in ambiguity, and is passionate about applying AI and emerging technologies to solve meaningful business problems.

Key Responsibilities: - Partner with business owners and enterprise leaders to define desired business outcomes and shape AI, emerging technology, and analytics solutions that directly support those outcomes.
- Lead end‑to‑end execution of strategic initiatives, from problem framing and solution design through delivery oversight and value realization.
- Facilitate executive‑level working sessions and workshops to drive alignment, decision‑making, and prioritization for complex, high‑impact initiatives.
- Translate ambiguous business challenges into clear hypotheses, options, and recommendations supported by data, analytics, and emerging technology capabilities.
- Co‑lead cross‑functional teams (technology, analytics, risk, operations) to ensure solutions are feasible, well‑governed, and executed effectively.
- Drive measurement of progress and outcomes, ensuring AI and analytics initiatives deliver against stated short‑, medium‑, and long‑term business objectives.
- Communicate strategy, execution plans, and progress to senior leadership through clear, compelling presentations and written materials.
- Monitor industry, competitive, and technology trends to inform solution design and proactively identify new opportunities for impact.
- Apply a detailed understanding of both qualitative and quantitative research methodologies and sampling designs to make recommendations to senior leaders on research approach; explaining the benefits (and drawbacks) of the design.

This position is known internally as Senior Manager - Themes Strategist

Current Internal home-based associates please note : Even as a campus-based posted role you are eligible to apply and, if selected, you may retain your home-based status. However future business or regulatory needs may require on-site work and some roles may carry a preference for campus-based presence.

Minimum Experience: - 6 + years experience in strategy consulting, business analysis, or analytics, with experience advising senior leaders on complex, ambiguous initiatives.
- Working knowledge of AI, analytics, and emerging technologies sufficient to shape solutions, assess trade‑offs, and guide execution (not hands‑on engineering).
- Deep understanding of wealth management and/or financial services business models, including how technology and analytics drive growth, efficiency, and client outcomes.
- Proven ability to lead cross‑functional delivery and translate strategy into executed outcomes.
- Understand, analyze, and recommend various research methodologies (both qualitative and quantitative) to address firm-wide business issues. Knowledge of statistics and analytical methodologies.

Preferred experience: - Advanced degree or certifications in Business, Analytics, Finance, Economics, or related fields.
- Prior experience shaping or delivering AI‑enabled or analytics‑driven solutions in regulated environments.
- Exposure to digital wealth management, practice management, or asset management, with a strong grasp of advisor and client workflows.
- Familiarity with value measurement, benefits realization, and change management for enterprise technology initiatives.

Candidates that live within a commutable distance from our Tempe, AZ and St. Louis, MO home office locations are expected to work in the office four days per week .

Edward Jones does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, religion, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, pregnancy, veteran status, genetic information or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

Edward Jones' compensation and benefits package includes medical and prescription drug, dental, vision, voluntary benefits (such as accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness), short- and long-term disability, basic life, and basic AD&D coverage. Short- and long-term disability, basic life, and basic AD&D coverage are provided at no cost to associates. Edward Jones offers a 401k retirement plan, and tax-advantaged accounts: health savings account, and flexible spending account. Edward Jones observes ten paid holidays and provides 15 days of vacation for new associates beginning on January 1 of each year, as well as sick time, personal days, and a paid day for volunteerism. Associates may be eligible for bonuses and profit sharing. All associates are eligible for the firm's Employee Assistance Program. For more information on the Benefits available to Edward Jones associates, please visit our benefits page .

jobs.title: Senior Supplier Operations Manager
jobs.description:
This job posting is anticipated to remain open for 30 days, from 22-Sep-2026. The posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.
We are seeking a highly experienced technology services strategist to serve as a senior individual contributor and trusted advisor to senior technology leadership. This role is responsible for helping shape the future of Edward Jones Digital workforce, technology services, evaluating emerging service delivery models, monitoring market trends, and ensuring the organization remains aligned with leading industry practices.
The successful candidate will possess deep expertise in technology services, managed services, vendor ecosystems, sourcing strategies, operating models, and commercial structures. They will provide thought leadership and actionable recommendations that help the organization optimize technology investments, workforce strategies, accelerate innovation, improve service outcomes, and maintain a competitive advantage. Through strong governance, industry insights, and collaboration, you will help create a resilient, scalable, and future-ready technology ecosystem that delivers measurable business value.

The Opportunity:
- Serve as the organization's subject matter expert on industry technology vendor trends and service delivery models.
- Continuously assess industry trends, market evolution, emerging capabilities, and leading practices across global technology services providers.
- Develop forward-looking technology workforce and service strategies that align with business objectives, technology roadmaps, and long-term operational goals.
- Provide thought leadership on future-state operating models, including managed services, outcome-based delivery, platform-enabled services, global delivery models, and emerging service ecosystems.

What You Will Do:
- Serve as a trusted advisor to Digital and business leaders on technology partner strategy, ecosystem design, workforce modernization, and technology investment priorities.
- Develop and refine technology workforce and service strategies across existing and emerging technology domains in partnership with cross-functional organizations.
- Identify opportunities to improve service quality, operational resilience, scalability, flexibility, and cost effectiveness.
- Guide workforce and operating model transformations, including managed services, business process outsourcing, and capability modernization initiatives.
- Orchestrate collaboration across Architecture, Engineering, Product, Sourcing, Legal, HR, Compliance, Finance, Third-Party Risk, Global Delivery Capabilities, and Technology leadership to align partner capabilities with strategic objectives.

Current Internal home-based associates please note : Even as a campus-based posted role you are eligible to apply and, if selected, you may retain your home-based status . However, future business or regulatory needs may require on-site work and some roles may carry a preference for campus-based presence.
What Experience You Need:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required.
- Extensive experience leading technology partner ecosystems across third party workforce services, outsourcing providers, cloud, software, infrastructure, and AI.
- Proven success delivering large-scale third-party workforce and technology transformation programs.
- Strong understanding of sourcing, supplier governance, strategic Technology service providers, and technology ecosystem.
- Staying current on emerging technologies, market trends, and innovation opportunities to inform enterprise strategy.
- Deep understanding of complex commercial agreements, including MSAs, SOWs, managed services, and strategic partnership frameworks.
- Experience leading workforce transformation, operating model modernization, and outsourced service delivery strategies.
- Strong financial and business acumen, including value realization, investment analysis, and performance management.
- Ability to influence senior executives and align diverse stakeholder groups around strategic outcomes through storytelling.
- Up to 10% travel.

**Candidates that live within a commutable distance from our Tempe, AZ and St. Louis, MO home office locations are expected to work in the office four days per week effective June 1, 2026. Before June 1, 2026, candidates that live within a commutable distance from our Tempe, AZ and St. Louis, MO home office locations are expected to work in the office three days per week, with preference for Tuesday through Thursday.**

Short- and long-term disability, basic life, and basic AD&D coverage are provided at no cost to associates. Edward Jones offers a 401k retirement plan, and tax-advantaged accounts: health savings account, and flexible spending account. Edward Jones observes ten paid holidays and provides 15 days of vacation for new associates beginning on January 1 of each year, as well as sick time, personal days, and a paid day for volunteerism. Associates may be eligible for bonuses and profit sharing. All associates are eligible for the firm's Employee Assistance Program. jobs.title: Lead Practice  Strategy  Consultant
Senior Treasury Analyst
jobs.description:
This job posting is anticipated to remain open for 30 days, from 09-Oct-2026. The posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.
Treasury Overview
The Treasury department plays a critical role in safeguarding the firm's liquidity and maintaining the strength of its balance sheet. We manage cash, funding, investments, and banking relationships to support operational, strategic, and regulatory requirements across multiple legal entities. Treasury is responsible for liquidity management, broker-dealer reserve funding, settlements with trading partners and clearing organizations, intercompany and interbank transfers, short-term investments, and treasury risk oversight. We partner closely with Finance, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and business leaders to optimize capital deployment, manage financial risks, and support the firm's growth objectives.

Sr. Treasury Analyst
The Sr. Treasury Analyst is responsible for leading liquidity management, cash forecasting, funding, investment, and treasury risk management activities across multiple regulated entities, including broker-dealers and trust companies. This role serves as a subject matter expert in liquidity management, reserve requirements, balance sheet optimization, and treasury operations, while driving process improvements, automation initiatives, and strategic treasury projects. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with the ability to influence stakeholders, provide actionable recommendations to leadership, and enhance the firm's liquidity position, risk management framework, and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities - Lead daily cash positioning, forecasting, funding, liquidity management, and bank account oversight across multiple operating and regulated entities
- Develop and execute cash concentration, funding, reserve management, and short-term investment strategies while ensuring compliance with SEC Rule 15c3-3 reserve requirements and other regulatory liquidity obligations
- Perform liquidity stress testing, scenario analysis, and contingency funding planning to assess funding adequacy and support liquidity risk management
- Monitor and optimize balance sheet utilization, liquidity resources, and capital deployment while identifying opportunities to improve financial efficiency and support strategic business objectives
- Identify, measure, and manage treasury related risks, including liquidity, interest rate, FX, counterparty, concentration, and operational risks; recommend mitigation and hedging strategies where appropriate
- Prepare and deliver executive level reporting and analysis on liquidity, cash flows, investments, reserve requirements, funding activities, risk exposures, and stress testing results, providing actionable recommendations to senior leadership
- Lead treasury transformation initiatives and partner with Finance, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Accounting teams to enhance controls, automate processes, implement technology solutions, and support strategic treasury initiatives

Current Internal home-based associates please note : Even as a campus-based posted role you are eligible to apply and, if selected, you may retain your home-based status . However future business or regulatory needs may require on-site work and some roles may carry a preference for campus-based presence.

Qualifications Required - BS/BA degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related field; MBA, CFA, CPA, or CTP preferred
- 7+ years of experience in Treasury, Cash Management, Banking, Corporate Finance, Capital Markets, or Liquidity Risk Management
- Strong knowledge of liquidity management, cash forecasting, balance sheet management, short-term investments, treasury risk management, and banking products
- Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills with experience analyzing large and complex data sets
- Strong analytical, communication, project management, and stakeholder management skills with a continuous improvement mindset

What Could Set You Apart - Experience managing liquidity, investments, funding, and reserve requirements across multiple legal entities and regulated businesses
- Knowledge of broker-dealer reserve requirements, customer protection rules, trust operations, and liquidity risk management frameworks
- Experience with GTreasury, Kyriba, Oracle Fusion, PeopleSoft, OneStream, or similar treasury and ERP platforms

Please note:
Associate's working hours must align to 8 am to 5 pm Central standard time

Candidates that live within a commutable distance from our Tempe, AZ and St. Louis, MO home office locations are expected to work in the office four days per week.

Edward Jones does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, religion, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, pregnancy, veteran status, genetic information or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

Edward Jones' compensation and benefits package includes medical and prescription drug, dental, vision, voluntary benefits (such as accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness), short- and long-term disability, basic life, and basic AD&D coverage. Short- and long-term disability, basic life, and basic AD&D coverage are provided at no cost to associates. Edward Jones offers a 401k retirement plan, and tax-advantaged accounts: health savings account, and flexible spending account. Edward Jones observes ten paid holidays and provides 15 days of vacation for new associates beginning on January 1 of each year, as well as sick time, personal days, and a paid day for volunteerism. Associates may be eligible for bonuses and profit sharing. All associates are eligible for the firm's Employee Assistance Program. jobs.title: Lead Practice  Strategy  Consultant
Senior AI Strategist - Futures Lab
jobs.description:
This job posting is anticipated to remain open for 30 days, from 08-Oct-2026. The posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.
The Futures Lab Sr. AI Strategist defines and pressure-tests future-state vision of how AI and emerging technologies may reshape the future of work, clients, and advice. This role translates enterprise strategy, external signals, and emerging technology shifts into decision-grade artifacts that help leaders look beyond near-term roadmap work, evaluate long-range strategic options, and determine what the firm should pursue and why before committing to funding, governance, or execution.
What You’ll Do
- Defines and continually refines future-state visions and strategic framing for AI-enabled systems, connecting long-range possibilities to business objectives, market signals, emerging technology trends, and future enterprise capabilities.
- Explores long-range AI and emerging technology opportunities to better inform roadmap priorities, clarifying which concepts should guide near-term strategy, remain exploratory, be reframed, or be stopped before they enter formal governance or delivery pathways.
- Identifies, frames, and evaluates potential AI and emerging-technology opportunity spaces, providing decision criteria and recommendations for consideration through established strategy, portfolio, and governance processes.
- Comfortable vibe-coding artifacts that help leaders evaluate trade-offs, dependencies, and capability implications across products, data, controls, and AI-enabled interactions.
- Models system-level impacts across Financial Advisors, associates, clients, AI systems, and enterprise platforms to ensure concepts are logically complete and evaluable across dependencies with emphasis on AI, emerging tech, hybrid intelligence, and related.
- Builds strategic alignment across business, design, technology, analytics, and governance stakeholders so future-state initiatives advance with shared purpose and realistic execution pathways.
- Shapes strategic narratives, decision materials, and roadmap-shaping inputs that clarify trade-offs, expected outcomes, and capability dependencies for executive audiences.
- Monitors external developments in AI, data, emerging tech, and related to refine priorities, strengthen competitive positioning, and surface new opportunities for value creation.
- Fosters new concepts, products, and services that drive competitive advantage, shaping how AI capabilities should be applied to create business value (conceptual fluency, not build-level expertise).
- Operates with high autonomy and exercises judgment in ambiguous, precedent-limited environments by structuring coherent futures where formal data, precedent, or governance inputs may not yet exist on decisions carrying significant cost, complexity, and long-term operating-model implications.
- Experience defining explicit assumptions, evidence gaps, decision criteria, and handoff conditions for exploratory concepts moving toward validation, governance, product discovery, or delivery.
- Partners with Experience, Firm Strategy Product, Technology, Data, Risk, and Compliance leaders to incorporate specialist evidence, avoid duplicate exploration, and establish clear transition points when a future-state concept is ready for deeper research, validation, product discovery, or delivery.

Current Internal home-based associates please note: Even as a campus-based posted role you are eligible to apply and, if selected, you may retain your home-based status. However future business or regulatory needs may require on-site work and some roles may carry a preference for campus-based presence.

Minimum Knowledge

Opportunity Overview
The Edward Jones Connection Team at Edward Jones exists to enable branch teams to optimize their practice by creating capacity, through serving clients in partnership.

The BSL will also contribute thought leadership to the strategy and execution of the department.  The role may include direct people leadership as well as dotted line leadership responsibilities for TLs as appropriate based on projects or initiatives.
